_comment: Manual test setups for the `!test` chat command (devcmd.rs). Each: label, about, where to go (goto: a test target kind with an optional enemy/target name and number, or playfield with an optional pos; neither = stay here), team (minifigure names, first active; optional), spawn (enemies by name around you for 15 minutes, no respawn, casting only `spells` when given; optional).

scenarios.label: smash
scenarios.about: 3 Crates and 3 Barrels around you where you stand (smash animation timing, loot bags)

scenarios.label: chase
scenarios.about: a Musketeer camp in Pirate World that chases you (enemy movement)

scenarios.label: boss
scenarios.about: Captain Dreadleg in the tutorial

scenarios.label: crowd
scenarios.about: 8 Pirate Corsairs around you where you stand (procs, buffs, area attacks)

scenarios.label: abilities
scenarios.about: enemies with different abilities around you (npc_spells.rs): Musketeer and Space Alien Ranger shots, Space Merc Brawler slash, Pirate Corsair spin, Satyr Shaman fire, Pirate Islander Scout trap, Space Merc Blaster volley

scenarios.label: blackheart
scenarios.about: the Pirate Grotto's Captain Dreadleg (was named Captain Blackheart) where you stand: his slash, spin (then stunned), shot and bomb

scenarios.label: bomb
scenarios.about: the Pirate Grotto's Captain Dreadleg where you stand, throwing only his bomb (238202: lands with a thud and a scorch, explodes 0.5 s later: 2 m around and in a cross of four 10 m arms)

scenarios.label: team
scenarios.about: Astronaut, Alien Trooper and Ballerina in the hub (animations, minifigure switching, health)

scenarios.label: kraken
scenarios.about: Crikey the Kraken's arena: he stays in the water past the floor and attacks from there

scenarios.label: darkside
scenarios.about: Planet's Dark Side, where the client hung while loading

scenarios.label: monkey-kong
scenarios.about: Monkey Cave, next to Monkey Kong: defeating him starts the Island Warrior rescue, whose end gives the Island Warrior (no reward bag besides; no minifigure bags drop there, only parts)

scenarios.label: egg
scenarios.about: Dinosaur Rise, in Quest_Tarpit: Return the egg to the nest starts; follow the arrow to the nest (dino_egg_1/2): entering Quest_TarpitComplete completes it (!goto quest lists the Gauntlet's room exits too)

goto.name: Return the egg to the nest

scenarios.label: combo
scenarios.about: Roman Commander with 4 Pirate Corsairs around you (Gladius Slash combo steps, hit sparks)

scenarios.label: dialogue
scenarios.about: Video Game Guy in the tutorial: his intro dialogue starts on arrival; talk to him for the next ones (!dialog lists all)

scenarios.label: modes
scenarios.about: Hun Warrior, Classic King and Mr. Good and Evil with 4 Pirate Corsairs (specials that swap both attacks: Mount Up!, Royal Steed, Evil Potion)

scenarios.label: evil
scenarios.about: Mr. Good and Evil with 4 Pirate Corsairs (Evil Potion swaps both attacks until Good Potion)

scenarios.label: king
scenarios.about: Classic King with 4 Pirate Corsairs (Royal Steed swaps both attacks for 5 s)

scenarios.label: sandstorm
scenarios.about: Egyptian Warrior with 4 Pirate Corsairs (Sand Storm: ground ring, dust and slow on enemies)

scenarios.label: clouds
scenarios.about: Mythology cloud jumpers: the wind fan throws you up three clouds to the top in one go (jumppad.rs chains)

scenarios.label: ravine
scenarios.about: Dinosaur Rise SwampToVolcano1: across the ravine via SwampToVolcano2 to the volcano side

scenarios.label: catapults
scenarios.about: a pair of Medieval Kingdom catapults: each lands you next to the other one

scenarios.label: cannon
scenarios.about: Pirate World's cannon bricks: build it, it shoots the fort wall, the guards take you to jail (cannon.rs)

scenarios.label: lilies
scenarios.about: Mythology wind fan onto two lily pads across the water and up to the far bank (jumppad.rs: lilies throw on)

scenarios.label: portal
scenarios.about: Volcano Island, standing in the portal to Pioneer Bay: it opens only after you walked 8 m away and came back

scenarios.label: newchar
scenarios.about: a new character's team (the Roman Commander starter only) at the tutorial's first trigger (HUD portrait)

scenarios.label: mirrors
scenarios.about: the Armory's mirror puzzle (mirrors.rs): use the mirrors to bring the light to the pedestal, which opens the Thunderbolt arena's entrance; !mirrors solve|reset

scenarios.label: mirrors2
scenarios.about: the Gauntlet's mirror puzzle (mirrors.rs): light both markers by the gate to open it; !mirrors solve|reset

scenarios.label: medusa
scenarios.about: Medusa's Lair: a gate with a mirror spot; build the mirror, its light opens the gate (gates.rs)

scenarios.label: plates
scenarios.about: the Gauntlet's plate room: step on all 30 plates to light them and open the east gate (plates.rs)

scenarios.label: pistons
scenarios.about: the Gauntlet's piston room: the pistons push out in turn and knock you off their ledge (pistons.rs)

scenarios.label: tiki
scenarios.about: the Gauntlet's Tiki room: build the 4 golden statues to break the skull's forcefield, dodge its fire (tiki.rs)

scenarios.label: ballista
scenarios.about: the Gauntlet's shooting room: use the levers to fire the two ballistas at the targets, which opens the east gate (ballista.rs)

scenarios.label: beachfight
scenarios.about: Isle of Yarr's Landing Beach: Commodore Moksey's navy fights the ghost pirates (Pirate Specters); both respawn (npc_fights.json, inferred)

scenarios.label: knightfight
scenarios.about: Medieval Kingdom outside the town gate: Knights of the Crown fight the troll siege camp; both respawn (npc_fights.json, inferred)

scenarios.label: bridgefight
scenarios.about: Isle of Yarr at the Jacket Bridge: ghost pirates and the Jackets' red coats attack each other (npc_fights.json rivals, inferred)

scenarios.label: volleys
scenarios.about: Galaxy Trooper, Revolutionary Soldier and Lizard Man with 6 Pirate Corsairs (specials that shoot every channel tick while held: Blaster Storm, Squad, RAWR)

scenarios.label: lobs
scenarios.about: Galaxy Patrol, Pirate Captain and Skydiver with 6 Pirate Corsairs (thrown bombs land on the target and explode: Extra Magnetic Grenade, Cross Bomb; Skydive leaps onto the enemies)

scenarios.label: eggs
scenarios.about: Chicken Suit Guy, Galaxy Patrol and Pirate Captain with 3 Broken Wagons and 4 Pirate Corsairs (eggs and bombs at smashables, also at one just smashed; lobs at enemies running at you: !aim lob current|lead)

scenarios.label: pulses
scenarios.about: Wizard, Cowboy and Lifeguard Guy with 6 Pirate Corsairs (Lightning Blast chains to nearby enemies, Wild Ride shoots the nearest enemy every tick, Sparkling Whirlpool hurts around you for 3 s)

scenarios.label: spin
scenarios.about: Barbarian with 6 Pirate Corsairs (Spin Slash: one continuous spin while held)

scenarios.label: monsters
scenarios.about: one each of 8 enemies with generic spells (npc_spells.json `generic`): Skeleton Archer arrows, Pirate Grenadier grenades, Harpy feathers, Hound bite, Troll Heavy Hitter area smash, Spider venom, Islander Witch Doctor potions, Treant smash

scenarios.label: orbits
scenarios.about: Fortune Teller, Sad Clown, Scarecrow and Trendsetter with 6 Pirate Corsairs (orbiting shots, ProjectileType 3: Wheel of Fortune's cards circle her, From Bad to Worse's clouds circle where it was aimed, Flock of Birds, Circle of Hearts)

scenarios.label: engineer
scenarios.about: two Space Merc Engineers (their bomb ring: four bombs circling the spot they cast it on, bursting on a player; and their shots)

scenarios.label: healers
scenarios.about: 2 Medics with 3 Musketeers around you (enemy_abilities.rs): hurt a Musketeer below 70% and a Medic throws it a heal bottle (20% of its maximum, every 8 s)

scenarios.label: shields
scenarios.about: shield enemies around you (enemy_abilities.rs): Skeleton Trident (itself, 8 s), Space Merc Defender (an ally, 6 s) with 2 Space Merc Brawlers, Ogre Defender (everyone within 6 m, 6 s), Gremlin Warlock (an ally); shielded enemies take tunables enemy_abilities.shields[].taken (0%: nothing)

scenarios.label: totem
scenarios.about: 2 Witch Doctors around you: knife stabs, and every 5 s from 3–10 m (up close only the knife) the client's XX_JuJu Totem (his totem animation, the mark under you, the hit within 2 m 1.5 s later)

scenarios.label: pets
scenarios.about: Zombie Cheerleader, Monster Scientist and Queen with 6 Pirate Corsairs: the specials' pets (Team Zombie, Gigantuan, Queen's Guard) hit by their owner casting the pet damage spell (server Lua 4355/4463/4581: ×0.25 / ×0.5 / ×0.5 of your power; log "pet attack: the owner casts")
